rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person's ability to see, including in phrases such as good or poor eyesight.

example.english: My eyesight has gotten much worse lately.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan6 paai4 si6 lik6 caa1 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this more casually when emphasizing how clearly or sharply someone can see rather than the general or medical sense.

example.english: Your eyesight is really sharp—you can see that far away.
example.traditional: 你眼力真係好，咁遠都睇到。
example.jyutping: nei5 ngaan5 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam3 jyun5 dou1 tai2 dou2
